test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Crocodile tears

options.text: To not behave in a fair way

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **An insincere display of grief**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Crocodile tears"** refers to an insincere show of emotion, especially grief, where the person pretends to be sad or remorseful but does not genuinely feel it. (मगरमच्छ के आँसू; दिखावटी दुःख)

 
 
• **Example:** The politician shed crocodile tears while addressing the plight of the poor, but no real action was taken.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: An irrevocable step** (अपरिवर्तनीय कदम): Refers to an action that cannot be undone or reversed.

 
 
• **Example:** Signing the contract was an irrevocable step in their business partnership.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: To not behave in a fair way** (अनुचित व्यवहार करना): Refers to being unfair or unjust in one's actions.
 
 
• **Example:** It is unethical to not behave in a fair way while judging a competition.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To please everyone** (सभी को खुश करना): Refers to making an effort to satisfy everyone, often at the cost of one's own needs or beliefs.
 
 
• **Example:** Trying to please everyone is a sure way to exhaust yourself.
 
 

1c4:Tc47,

The correct answer is: **Option 1 (terminated)**.
